'''Chen Jisheng''' ({{lang-zh|s={{linktext|陈|冀|胜}}|t={{linktext|陳|冀|勝}}|p=Chén Jìshèng}}; 15 July 1932 – 19 October 2022) was a Chinese medical officer and pharmaceutical chemist, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]]. He was a member of the [[Chinese Communist Party]] and a [[major general]] (''[[Jiang (rank)|shaojiang]]'') in the [[People's Liberation Army]].

==Biography==
Chen was born in [[Tianjin]], on 15 July 1932.<ref name="chen">{{cite news |author1=Li Yuan ({{lang|zh|李苑}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_20373379 |script-title=zh:军事医学与药物化学专家陈冀胜院士逝世 |work=thepaper |date=20 October 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1937, by age 5, his family fled the [[Second Sino-Japanese War]] and finally settled down in [[Chongqing]], where he passed his basic education.<ref name="ji">{{cite news |author1=Xu Huibo ({{lang|zh|徐汇博}}) |author2=Zhang Cheng ({{lang|zh|张诚}}) |url=http://www.81.cn/yw/2022-01/08/content_10121794.htm |script-title=zh:中国工程院院士、著名军事化学家陈冀胜：为祖国打造防化坚盾 |work=81.cn |date=8 January 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> In September 1942, Chen joined the underground party organization of the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) when he was a chemistry major at [[Fudan University]].<ref name="ji"/>

In 1950, the [[Korean War]] broke out, in response to the call of the Communist Party, Chen was the first to sign up and mobilized eight students to join the [[People's Liberation Army]] (PLA), becoming chemical prevention cadets.<ref name="ji"/> Due to chemical defense cadets need professional knowledge, they were sent to [[Tsinghua University]], [[Peking University]] and other universities to continue their studies.<ref name="ji"/> After graduating from Tsinghua University in July 1952, he became a teacher at the Chemical Warfare School.<ref name="chen"/> He joined the Institute of Chemical Prevention Science and Technology in October 1954, and moved to the 13th Research Institute of National Defense Science and Technology Commission in March 1970. He was a deputy director of a research institute of the [[People's Liberation Army General Staff Department]] in July 1981 and subsequently [[Chinese Communist Party Committee Secretary|party secretary]] and deputy director of the Chemical Prevention Research Institute of the [[Academy of Military Sciences (China)|PLA Academy of Military Sciences]] in January 1983.<ref name="chen"/> He attained the rank of [[major general]] (''[[Jiang (rank)|shaojiang]]'') in 1990.<ref name="ji"/>

On 19 October 2022, he died of an illness in [[Beijing]], at the age of 90.<ref name="chen"/><ref>{{cite news |author1=Sun Zonghe ({{lang|zh|孙宗鹤}}) |url=https://news.gmw.cn/2022-10/25/content_36110594.htm |script-title=zh:陈冀胜院士在京逝世 享年90岁 |work=gmw.cn |date=25 October 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>
